messages:
elena_cs: Quick weekly check for Clearpoint — overall error rate is 2.9% (WoW +2.3%). Can we run a focused triage on 5xx / timeouts / rate-limits and list the top failing endpoints?

samir_eng: grabbing logs now, will post top endpoints in a minute. @maya_sre FYI.

maya_sre: saw a latency tail for their prod region (eu-west-1) overnight, might be node churn. checking node-reboot and oom logs.

jonah_support: customer reports timeouts during dataset import. asked for repro timestamps and sample payloads.

elena_cs: thanks. here's a quick query I ran against monitoring (7d window):

```
metric: error_rate_total{customer="clearpoint"} | window(7d) | group_by(endpoint) | sort(desc)
```

--- Top 5 failing endpoints (7d):
1) POST /api/v1/import — 35% of errors (mix of 5xx + timeouts)
2) POST /v1/generate — 22% (mostly 502/504)
3) GET /api/v1/status/stream — 14% (timeouts / client disconnect)
4) POST /v1/batch-embed — 12% (rate-limited bursts)
5) POST /api/v1/route/score — 6% (intermittent 500s)
Other endpoints: 11%

samir_eng: digging into logs — repeated 502s from model-host pool-7 between 03:12–03:20 UTC. main trace: "connection reset by peer" in inference runtime.

maya_sre: confirmed node restarts on pool-7 at 03:15 UTC; dmesg shows OOM killer on one worker. suspect recent runtime change increased mem footprint.

elena_cs: @liam_prod was there a deploy to the inference runtime around that time?

liam_prod: there was a canary rollout of runtime v2.3.1 starting ~02:50 UTC (deployment id dpl-8742). Canary completed on a subset of pools; no automated rollback triggered.

opsbot: Deploy v2.3.1 -> prod started by liam_prod at 02:50 UTC (deployment id: dpl-8742).

jonah_support: I'll tell Clearpoint we're investigating; ask them for exact error timestamps (they gave a few: 03:14:05, 03:16:09 UTC).

samir_eng: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) pin Clearpoint to model-variant stable-2 (lower mem), 2) enable prefix KV cache for import flow to reduce mem churn, 3) temporarily scale back canary to avoid pool-7.

elena_cs: next steps: 1) @liam_prod evaluate rollback or isolate affected pool, 2) @maya_sre validate OOM triggers and node configs, 3) @jonah_support update customer with ETA and collect repros. I'll flag renewal owner if we see repeated regressions. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: Incident INC-7892 created (Clearpoint 5xx spike) — assigned to eng-oncall.
